domain: fusion of optimal-foraging/bandit allocation theory with intelligence-collection provenance doctrine — the tasking, grading, and expiry of exploration budget itself, whose fused object is the warrant: a tasked, graded, expiring unit of search spend
axioms: An allocation change is a product: a shift in budget, model tier, or next-turn attention is a claim about the world and must be traceable to a warrant even though nothing was written down.

The parents' tension is structural and is investigated, not resolved: exactly the candidates that move attention are the ones no read filter can stop, and exactly the candidates a read filter can stop may move no attention. Every contract sits somewhere on that diagonal and must say where.
Expiry and patch memory pull on the same record — what must decay as belief must persist as budget state — so a contract that names only one store has not answered the question.

A trigger keyed to the agent's own state estimate is self-tasking; without an issuing authority, exploration budget is released by the party that wants it, which is authority laundering in the budget domain.
Discovery counts are meaningless without a warrant per probe: an unattributed discovery cannot distinguish a better policy from a larger licence from a contaminated shared store.
A fused finding must collapse if either parent's primitive is removed; anything that survives single-parent reasoning belongs to that parent.
primitives: warrant — a tasked, graded, expiring unit of exploration budget
markable versus unmarkable output (graded product versus behavior change)
patch prior as an ungraded inherited claim that steers spend
self-tasking predicate and its issuing authority
dual store: decaying belief record versus non-decaying lead/budget ledger
grade-weighted, arm-attributed discovery event and regret
laundering-into-behavior path (unpromoted speculation to allocation knob)
failure_mode: Can manufacture cross-terms rhetorically — risks relabeling a single-parent finding as fused by attaching a decorative intersection_justification.
Its central move, demanding a warrant for every spend, imports bureaucracy that may cost more than the exploration it governs.
Treats 'add a record' as the universal repair, inflating contracts rather than eliminating candidates at the hard gates.
May over-index on the pilot's measurement machinery and under-serve the semantic-phase question the charter actually asks.
Weak on mnemonic quality, phase count, and whether any of this deserves a letter at all.
